decisive_items: mild synovitis in the right second MCP joint
response.rationale: Anti-CCP2 >300 is highly specific for rheumatoid arthritis, coupled with symmetric small-joint synovitis and elevated MMP-3/ESR/CRP. Although entheseal findings exist, the serologic and synovial pattern strongly favor RA over seronegative spondyloarthritis or isolated tendinitis/tendinosis.

rejected.why: Enthesitis is a feature but not the unifying diagnosis; anti-CCP positivity and MCP/MTP synovitis indicate RA.
Tendinitis describes a local tendon phenomenon, insufficient to explain polyarticular synovitis and highly positive anti-CCP.
Seronegative SpA is unlikely given strongly positive anti-CCP2 and rheumatoid factor; pattern is RA-associated enthesitis/synovitis.
Tendinosis is a degenerative label; ultrasound shows active inflammation (power Doppler), not purely degenerative, and systemic serology favors RA.
